product_title: Handcrafted Pink Thread and Pearl Decorative Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Elevate your festive decor with this elegant handcrafted tealight holder set, featuring vibrant pink thread-wrapped bases, intricate golden lattice metal holders, and beautiful pearl and gold bead embellishments. The rich colours and traditional detailing create a luxurious look, making these decorative pieces perfect for Diwali celebrations, pooja rooms, festive table settings, wedding decor, and special occasions. Add a touch of Indian craftsmanship and timeless charm to your home with this exquisite decorative set.
product_care_suggestion: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Keep the pink thread and pearl embellishments away from water and excessive moisture.
Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive cleaners, and rough handling.
Keep away from direct sunlight for extended periods to help preserve the colour and finish.
If using with tealight candles, ensure the candle flame does not come into direct contact with the holder to prevent damage.
Store in a dry place in a protective box or fabric bag when not in use.
